measured.note: Pull request #6 head; merged to main as 6abcefbf30efbffa95fc4b8384c2e9def34fc0ed and deployed as Lambda version 6.

index.embedded_text: one vector per card: title, summary, claims and skills

ranking: cosine similarity between the query and each card vector; all cards ranked, gap cards included

definitions.requirements: every dev and test requirement with non-empty evidence, whatever its verdict (does_not_meet requirements that cite gap cards included)
definitions.expected: every card the requirement cites, gap cards included
definitions.recall@k: share of the expected cards in the top k, averaged over the requirements
definitions.mrr: mean of 1 / rank of the first expected card
definitions.failure: a requirement with an expected card outside the top 5

latency_ms.where: GitHub-hosted runner calling Bedrock in us-east-1, not the Lambda

smoke.query: Terraform remote state and keyless GitHub OIDC deploys
